description: The utility SHALL be a file-processing tool implemented in C according to the C11 standard for Linux; the utility SHALL use only libc, libssl/libcrypto, and libcurl as external dependencies; the code SHALL compile without warnings with: `gcc -O2 -o ferramenta de processamento main.c -lssl -lcrypto -lcurl`; the utility SHALL include a Makefile with an 'all' target that compiles the project and a Makefile with a 'clean' target that removes the binary and .o files.
name: compilacao_e_dependencias
